identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.core_principle: Digital Concierge. The interface should feel like a high-end hotel lobby—quiet, attentive, and luxurious.

theme.strategy: Nocturnal Elegance. The default experience is a rich, warm dark mode optimized for low-light environments (discretion). Light mode is available but secondary, styled like a high-end art gallery (cream/off-white).

primary.description: Muted Champagne Gold. Used sparingly for primary actions and refined borders.

background.description: Rich Obsidian. Not pure black. Contains a hint of warm blue/purple to feel 'expensive'.

text.description: Off-white (Bone) for text. Pure white is too harsh.

headings.usage: Use for all Section Headers and Hero Text. Letter-spacing: -0.02em.

body.usage: Use for UI elements, labels, and long-form text. Clean, geometric but friendly.

border_radius.philosophy: Sharp edges denote precision and luxury. Avoid rounded 'friendly' corners unless strictly necessary for circular avatars.

rules: Overlap elements: Text should slightly overlap images to create depth (z-index layering).

containers.card_style: Minimalist. No shadows by default. 1px border in #27272A. Hover: Border color shifts to #C6A87C (Gold).

buttons.primary: bg-[#C6A87C] text-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#D4B88C] px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ease-out
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#3F3F46] text-[#F2F0ED] hover:border-[#C6A87C] hover:text-[#C6A87C] px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm transition-all

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#3F3F46] focus:border-[#C6A87C] px-0 py-4 text-lg text-[#F2F0ED] placeholder:text-[#52525B] focus:ring-0 rounded-none transition-colors
inputs.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#71717A] mb-2 block

provider_card.structure: Image-first. Aspect ratio 3:4. Name and details appear on hover via a subtle slide-up glass overlay.
provider_card.interaction: No 'View Profile' buttons. The whole card is the trigger. Cursor changes to 'Explore'.

navigation.style: Floating glass header. blur-md bg-[#0A0A0C]/80 border-b border-white/5. Logo on left, Minimal links right. 'Login' is a text link, 'Join' is a minimal gold border button.

visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 0.03) to the entire app background to kill digital flatness.

motion.scroll: Use 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. Essential for luxury feel.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers and modal overlays. Backdrop-blur-xl + bg-black/40 + border-white/10.

media.image_style: Cinematic, High Contrast, Noir. Faces often in shadow or silhouette for discretion.

landing.hero: Split screen or Center Focus. Headline: 'The Art of Companionship'. Subtext: 'Discreet. Curated. Exceptional.' CTA: 'Inquire Now'.
landing.features: Bento Grid layout showcasing 'Verification', 'Privacy', 'Selection'. Use icons from 'phosphor-icons' (Thin weight).

browse.layout: Masonry or Strict Grid. High-quality cover images. Minimal text (Name, Age, Location). Price hidden until click (luxury tactic).
browse.filters: Sidebar slide-over. Don't clutter the top bar.

profile.layout: Magazine Spread. Left: Portrait Series (Carousel). Right: Biography & Details. Typography focuses on storytelling.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Gold text on Black background meets 4.5:1. If not, lighten the Gold to #E5D2B0.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards without heavy customization (remove shadows, sharpen corners).
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Load 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts.
Do NOT use gradients on text. It looks cheap.
ALWAYS add data-testid to interactive elements.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (styled as minimal black strips).
Scrollbars: Hide default scrollbars, use custom thin gold track or none.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a digital sanctuary. Every pixel must feel intentional. If it looks like a Bootstrap template, you have failed. Prioritize atmosphere and negative space over density.
